title: Executive demo: delivery to verified certificate
banner: CANDIDATE ORACLES, SYNTHETIC DATA, TEST-ONLY KEYS. NOT THE PLATFORM (it does not exist). No Azure resource is involved.

lines.text: Methodology method:M-SYNTH@1 and factor set factorSet:F-SYNTH@1 were proposed, reviewed and approved by three different people (SYNTHETIC values, not any scheme's method). approved=true

2. EVIDENCE BOUND: chain verified independently (ok=true, complete=true); evidence manifest cd15c2d08d49; delivered 2500.0 kg; 5 signed receipts.
3. EMISSIONS ATTRIBUTE: 3.75 synthetic-units from method:M-SYNTH@1 and factorSet:F-SYNTH@1 (deterministic code, no model). Re-run reproduces it: true.
4a. DRAFTED by an agent, VALIDATED by the validator service (state VALIDATED). The agent cannot validate, approve or issue.
4b. APPROVED by a human quality manager (signed with their key, bound to this exact content), then ISSUED by the issuer service (state ISSUED).
5. SHIPOWNER VERIFIES: VALID-AS-OF (2026-03-10T09:50:00.000Z), using only the signer's public key and the certificate file. Certificate hash 5a020359436e.
6. TIME SAVED: not measured. The platform does not exist; the scenario model assumes the figures shown on the slide, labelled SCENARIO.
